treatment.definition: Full installed reviewerest skill package under a common minimal output format.
treatment.skill_on: Provide the pinned full package and explicitly invoke reviewerest-eval:review.
treatment.skill_off: Do not provide or load reviewerest or its report contract; disable skill expansion.
treatment.common_access: Same source packet, minimal schema, read-only local inspection and base host restrictions. No artifact execution, edits, network retrieval or external references.
treatment.reference_difference: Packaged references are part of the treatment and available only on. Specialist-reference permission does not imply off receives the skill package. This is not a core-instructions-only comparison.

candidate_limits.cost_note: These are requested CLI limits, not predicted cost or a guaranteed billing ceiling; in-flight responses can overshoot and CLI estimates can differ from billing.

assessor_plan.allowed_payload: Only one source case, its accepted criteria/common rules and exact candidate finding/location/claim/severity fields. No condition mapping, skill body, peer outputs, candidate traces or historical labels.
assessor_plan.required_records: Reason per entry; case-level recovery and clean judgment; separate note/severity diagnostics and exposure declaration.
assessor_plan.cost_note: Local agy --help exposes no dollar-cap option. No assessor cost estimate or enforceable dollar ceiling has been established. Assessor usage requires separate explicit bounds before live-run approval.

failure_policy.candidate_shape_or_location_error: Retain the scheduled trial without retries; record structural/location outcome separately and assess readable claims where faithful extraction permits.
failure_policy.runtime_or_integrity_failure: Stop before the next paid call on timeout, host/model drift, unsuccessful required skill load, prohibited action attempt, workspace mutation, missing usage record or manifest mismatch. Preserve unfinished schedule and all captures.
failure_policy.assessment_failure: Retain the failed assessment; do not repair or repeat automatically. Report unavailable judgments separately and stop on runtime or integrity failure.

implementation_status.offline_boundary_tests: Not implemented for this new matched design. Existing helper tests do not establish these behaviors.

pre_execution_requirements: Implement and test matched candidate runner, assessor adapter, assessment record validation and diagnostic-preserving aggregation.
Freeze their source bytes, common prompts, assessor protocol and schema before execution.
Verify installed host model selectors and actual restricted startup context; preserve exposure and host-policy limits.
Resolve assessor cost/call authorization and capture method; then obtain explicit approval for the complete live-run plan.
limits: Planned design, not an executable runner or observed treatment effect.
Six development cases with three repeats each are not eighteen independent source cases per arm.
Withholding condition metadata does not guarantee writing style cannot reveal the arm.
